rationale.hitl-workflow: Makes genuine intervention authority a necessary condition for effective oversight.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Requires epistemic access supported by understandability, interpretability, and system information.
rationale.oversight-theater: Rejects observer-only oversight, pseudo-options, and nominal safeguards lacking effective power.
rationale.automation-bias: Analyzes capable overseers losing vigilance and epistemic access through over-reliance.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Evaluates EU AI Act Article 14 against its effectiveness conditions.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes both categorical oversight dismissal and uncritical regulatory reliance.
